title: Federated Free Storage Mesh - provider admission record
description: One row of the provider registry (Spec S16). It records what has been *verified* about a backend - whether its free tier is real for this account, whether a hard stop exists, whether spillover could become billable - and never what the provider's marketing page claims. That distinction is the whole point of the record, so it is encoded structurally: free_status may only reach a VERIFIED_* value when the accompanying evidence class is runtime_account_evidence, and any row that is not verified free is forced to health QUARANTINED with autonomous_write_allowed pinned false. The same technique closes the other three doors: an external provider cannot be admitted for LOCAL_ONLY data, cannot omit encryption for CONFIDENTIAL data, and cannot claim a provider_id in the reserved 'local_' namespace; and a Supabase row cannot declare itself a bulk object backend. The record carries no credential of any kind - no token, no key, no account identifier - and the field set is closed so that one cannot be added later under a new name.

adapter_type.description: The integration shape, not a vendor product name. Determines which structural rules below apply.

external.description: True when the bytes leave owned/local storage. Drives the privacy rules below; it is not a free-form descriptor.

free_status.description: UNVERIFIED is the honest default and the state every provider starts in. DOCUMENTED_ONLY records that a free tier is *claimed* somewhere - it is explicitly not a verification and grants nothing. Only runtime/account evidence can produce a VERIFIED_* value.

free_expiry_at.description: Null means unknown, and unknown means NO_AUTONOMOUS_WRITE per Spec S11 - not 'probably fine'.

hard_stop_verified.description: Whether this account has been observed to stop rather than bill when the free allowance ends. False blocks autonomous writes below.

paid_spillover_possible.description: Tri-state on purpose. 'unknown' is not false: Spec S11 makes unverified billable spillover NO_AUTONOMOUS_WRITE, and a boolean would have forced a guess.

health.description: The runtime states of Spec S10. There is no 'UNKNOWN': a provider nobody has probed is QUARANTINED, which is the same fact stated so that it fails closed.

preferred_tiers.description: Spec S17 placement preferences. A preference, never a binding or an entitlement.

acceptable_use_class.description: Spec S17: Hugging Face is for legitimate models, datasets and benchmark corpora, not a generic log dump. Recording the class keeps that a machine-checkable constraint rather than a paragraph nobody rereads.

allOf.title: Verified free status requires runtime/account evidence
allOf.description: Spec S16/S20. A provider's own documentation is not evidence about this account: free tiers change, differ by region, and do not survive an expired promotion. So a VERIFIED_* value is only reachable when the evidence class is runtime_account_evidence and it carries a timestamp and a reference.

allOf.title: Anything not verified free is quarantined and cannot be written to
allOf.description: The fail-closed half of the rule above. UNVERIFIED, DOCUMENTED_ONLY, PAID_ONLY and FREE_EXPIRED all land in the same place, which is the point: 'we read that it is free' and 'we have not looked' are the same amount of evidence.

allOf.title: No hard stop, no autonomous writes
Possible or unknown paid spillover, no autonomous writes
Unknown free expiry, no autonomous writes unless recurring-free is verified
allOf.description: Spec S11 FREE_EXPIRY_UNKNOWN=NO_AUTONOMOUS_WRITE unless the provider is known recurring-free.

allOf.title: LOCAL_ONLY is not admissible on an external provider
allOf.description: Spec S4. Not 'discouraged' - the enum an external row is validated against does not contain the value.

allOf.title: An external provider admitted for CONFIDENTIAL must require encryption
allOf.description: Spec S4/S21: CONFIDENTIAL leaves owned storage only as ciphertext, so admitting the class and not requiring the encryption is a contradiction the registry refuses to hold.

allOf.title: The 'local_' provider_id namespace is reserved for owned storage
allOf.description: This is what makes the LOCAL_ONLY rule in storage_object_manifest.schema.json airtight. That schema permits only 'local_*' backend ids for LOCAL_ONLY objects; if an external provider could be registered as 'local_r2', the guarantee would be a naming convention rather than a control.

allOf.title: An owned local store is not an external free tier
allOf.description: Local storage has no free-tier entitlement to verify and no provider that could bill for it, so the cost machinery reads NOT_APPLICABLE rather than being answered with a guess.

allOf.title: Supabase is metadata and index only
allOf.description: Spec S6/S18/S25. Supabase holds the object manifest, not the objects, and it is not authority. Encoded here rather than left to placement logic, because a metadata service that can be declared a bulk backend will eventually be used as one.

provider_id.description: A stable registry key. Lower-case and underscore-only, so it cannot carry a URL, an '=' or whitespace - a credential-shaped 'KEY=VALUE' string has nowhere to go.

class_token.description: A short classifier from a controlled vocabulary. Same reasoning as everywhere else in this lane: a field that can hold a sentence can hold a secret.

evidence_ref.description: A pointer into the existing evidence path. Shaped so that 'TODO' and 'n/a' do not satisfy an evidence requirement.

free_status_evidence.description: Where the free-status claim came from. The whole registry turns on this field: 'provider_documentation' is a marketing page and buys nothing, 'runtime_account_evidence' is something observed about this account and is the only class that can unlock a VERIFIED_* status.

authority_flags.description: Denied by name rather than by omission, matching storage_object_manifest.schema.json.
